description: Interact with Frappe/ERPNext sites — document CRUD, search, and whitelisted method calls
name: io.github.muthanii/frappe_mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Frappe/ERPNext site, e.g. https://your-site.erpnext.com
environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Frappe API key for token-based authentication
environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Frappe API secret paired with the API key
environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_API_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to 'true'.
environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_VERIFY_SSL

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
environmentVariables.name: FRAPPE_TIMEOUT

title: Frappe MCP Server
